top_signals.title: Stocks are hitting records despite surging yields. Cramer explains why
top_signals.summary: CNBC’s Jim Cramer said Nvidia, Microsoft and Meta are helping push stocks to records even as surging Treasury yields pressure much of the broader market.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
